qe: The historic 1916 annual session of the Indian National Congress witnessed the formal readmission of the Extremists to the Congress fold. Who presided over this landmark session?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के ऐतिहासिक 1916 के वार्षिक सत्र में कांग्रेस के भीतर गरमदल (Extremists) की औपचारिक वापसी हुई। इस ऐतिहासिक सत्र की अध्यक्षता किसने की थी?
o: Ambika Charan Majumdar
Rashbehari Ghosh
Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Annie Besant
e: Detailed Explanation: The 1916 Lucknow session of the Indian National Congress was presided over by the Moderate leader Ambika Charan Majumdar (A.C. Majumdar). This session successfully ended the nine-year ideological separation that began after the Surat split of 1907.

qe: To allay Moderate suspicions and facilitate the 1916 reunion, Bal Gangadhar Tilak made which of the following strategic public declarations?
qh: नरमपंथियों के संदेह को दूर करने और 1916 के पुनर्मिलन को सुगम बनाने के लिए बाल गंगाधर तिलक ने निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी रणनीतिक सार्वजनिक घोषणा की थी?
o: He declared his support for administrative reforms rather than an overthrow of the government, and explicitly denounced acts of violence
He demanded the immediate execution of a nationwide passive resistance campaign targeting local municipalities
He advocated for the complete structural dissolution of the non-official seats in the Imperial Legislative Council
He pledged absolute structural compliance with the pro-landlord policies of the British Indian Association
e: Detailed Explanation: To reassure the conservative Moderate leadership, Lokmanya Tilak clarified his political stance before the 1916 session by declaring that his movement sought the programmatic reform of the existing administration rather than the violent overthrow of the government, and he openly denounced acts of violence.

qe: The death of which two prominent Moderate leaders, who had historically spear-headed the fierce resistance against Extremist methodologies, significantly smoothed the path for the 1916 Congress reunion?
qh: किन दो प्रमुख नरमपंथी (Moderate) नेताओं के निधन ने, जिन्होंने ऐतिहासिक रूप से गरमदलीय कार्यप्रणालियों के खिलाफ कड़े प्रतिरोध का नेतृत्व किया था, 1916 के कांग्रेस पुनर्मिलन के मार्ग को काफी आसान बना दिया?
o: Gopal Krishna Gokhale and Pherozshah Mehta
Mahadeo Govind Ranade and Raghunath Rao
W.C. Bonnerjee and Dadabhai Naoroji
Dinshaw Wacha and Surendranath Banerjea
e: Detailed Explanation: Gopal Krishna Gokhale and Sir Pherozshah Mehta were the pillars of the conservative Moderate faction who strictly opposed the entry of Extremists. Their passing in 1815 removed the main structural opposition within the Congress high command, facilitating the reunion.

qe: The shift in the Muslim League's political attitude toward an anti-imperialist stance before 1916 was heavily triggered by Britain’s refusal to assist Turkey during which international conflicts?
qh: 1916 से पहले मुस्लिम लीग के राजनीतिक रुख में साम्राज्यवादी विरोधी रुख में बदलाव मुख्य रूप से किस अंतर्राष्ट्रीय संघर्ष के दौरान तुर्की को सहायता देने से ब्रिटेन के इनकार के कारण शुरू हुआ था?
o: The Balkan Wars (1912-13) and the war with Italy (1911)
The structural campaigns of the American Civil War
The primary geopolitical outbreaks of the Franco-Prussian conflict
The maritime naval tracking blockades inside the open sea channels
e: Detailed Explanation: The Indian Muslim intelligentsia was deeply angered by Britain's hostile foreign policy toward the Ottoman Empire (Turkey), whose ruler was revered as the Khalifa. Britain's refusal to assist Turkey in its war with Italy (1911) and during the Balkan Wars (1912–13) alienated Indian Muslims from the empire.

qe: Apart from global geopolitical events, which domestic administrative decision taken by the British government in India in 1911 severely annoyed and alienated the Muslim political elite?
qh: वैश्विक भू-राजनीतिक घटनाओं के अलावा, 1911 में भारत में ब्रिटिश सरकार द्वारा लिए गए किस घरेलू प्रशासनिक निर्णय ने मुस्लिम राजनीतिक अभिजात वर्ग को गंभीर रूप से नाराज और अलग थलग कर दिया था?
o: The formal Annulment of the Partition of Bengal
The structural implementation of the Seditious Meetings Act regulations
The complete legal transfer of the capital from Calcutta to Delhi
The total abolition of separate income qualification thresholds for voters
e: Detailed Explanation: The Muslim political elite had strongly supported Curzon's 1905 partition plan because it promised a Muslim-majority province in East Bengal. The sudden reversal and formal 'Annulment of the Partition' by the government in 1911 was seen as a betrayal of their interests.

qe: The British Indian government refused to grant a specific structural power to the newly proposed university setup at Aligarh, further alienating the younger Muslim intelligentsia. What power was denied?
qh: ब्रिटिश भारतीय सरकार ने अलीगढ़ में नए प्रस्तावित विश्वविद्यालय सेटअप को एक विशिष्ट संरचनात्मक शक्ति देने से इनकार कर दिया, जिससे युवा मुस्लिम बुद्धिजीवी और अधिक अलग हो गए। कौन सी शक्ति देने से इनकार किया गया था?
o: The legal power to affiliate colleges all over India
The structural capacity to print independent regional currencies
The right to completely exclude modern Western physical sciences from its curriculum
The authority to host competitive civil service testing examinations locally
e: Detailed Explanation: The Muslim intelligentsia wanted to establish a centralized university at Aligarh with expansive powers to affiliate colleges across the entire country. The colonial government's refusal to grant these affiliating powers caused widespread discontent among the younger educated class.

qe: At its Calcutta session in 1912, the Muslim League introduced a major reorientation of its baseline charter to align more closely with national aspirations. What goal did it formally commit to?
qh: 1912 के अपने कलकत्ता सत्र में, मुस्लिम लीग ने राष्ट्रीय आकांक्षाओं के साथ अधिक निकटता से तालमेल बिठाने के लिए अपने बुनियादी चार्टर में एक बड़ा बदलाव पेश किया। इसने औपचारिक रूप से किस लक्ष्य के प्रति प्रतिबद्धता जताई?
o: Working with other groups for a system of self-government suited to India, provided it protected Muslim interests
The complete, violent armed overthrow of the British Raj within a decade
The strict permanent insulation of all intermediate zamindari revenue collection systems
Launching an aggressive nationwide shuddhi campaign across rural subdivisions
e: Detailed Explanation: In 1912, the younger nationalist elements influenced the League to redefine its goals. At its Calcutta session, the League formally committed to working alongside other political bodies to achieve a system of self-government suited to India, bringing its agenda closer to that of the Congress.

qe: During the First World War, the colonial government aggressively suppressed progressive Muslim journalism. Which highly influential nationalist publications edited by Maulana Azad and Mohammad Ali faced severe state repression?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान, औपनिवेशिक सरकार ने प्रगतिशील मुस्लिम पत्रकारिता को आक्रामक रूप से दबा दिया। मौलाना आज़ाद और मोहम्मद अली द्वारा संपादित किन अत्यधिक प्रभावशाली राष्ट्रवादी प्रकाशनों को गंभीर सरकारी दमन का सामना करना पड़ा?
o: Al Hilal and Comrade
Tahdhib-ul-Akhlaq and Rast Goftar
Darpan and Digdarshan
Hitavada and India weekly
e: Detailed Explanation: To curb the growth of anti-imperialist sentiments among the 'Young Party', the state banned Maulana Azad's newspaper 'Al Hilal' and Mohammad Ali's weekly journal 'Comrade', subsequently interning both leaders along with Hasrat Mohani.

qe: The landmark Lucknow Pact of 1916 between the Indian National Congress and the All India Muslim League involved a major constitutional compromise. What regressive principle did the Congress formally accept?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस और अखिल भारतीय मुस्लिम लीग के बीच 1916 के ऐतिहासिक लखनऊ समझौते (Lucknow Pact) में एक बड़ा संवैधानिक समझौता शामिल था। कांग्रेस ने औपचारिक रूप से किस प्रतिगामी सिद्धांत को स्वीकार किया?
o: The Muslim League's position on separate electorates and a fixed proportion of seats in the legislatures
The total legal abolition of the newly constituted Federal Court system
The direct physical restriction of women from participating in provincial elections
The absolute non-cooperation guidelines barring any Indian from entering executive councils
e: Detailed Explanation: In a historic compromise to build a joint anti-colonial front, the Congress formally accepted the system of separate electorates for Muslims and agreed to grant them a fixed proportion of reserved seats in both central and provincial legislatures.

qe: Under the schedule of joint constitutional demands presented to the government under the Lucknow Pact, what definitive declaration did the two organizations demand regarding India's political status?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते के तहत सरकार को सौंपे गए संयुक्त संवैधानिक मांगों के चार्टर के तहत, दोनों संगठनों ने भारत की राजनीतिक स्थिति के संबंध में किस निश्चित घोषणा की मांग की थी?
o: That the British Government should declare its intention to confer self-government on Indians at an early date
The immediate and complete absolute extraction of all British managing agencies from coastal ports
The direct legal transfer of the absolute command of the armed forces to the Indian National Congress
A complete legislative termination of the office of the Secretary of State for India based in London
e: Detailed Explanation: The foremost demand of the unified Congress-League platform was that the British Crown must issue an official declaration promising to confer full self-government on the Indian people at an early date.

qe: The Lucknow Pact demanded structural expansions within the representative assemblies at both the central and provincial levels. What modification did they demand regarding the legislative composition?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते में केंद्रीय और प्रांतीय दोनों स्तरों पर प्रतिनिधि विधानसभाओं के भीतर संरचनात्मक विस्तार की मांग की गई थी। उन्होंने विधायी संरचना के संबंध में किस संशोधन की मांग की थी?
o: The assemblies should be further expanded with a clear elected majority and endowed with more powers
The complete abolition of all elective non-official seats in favor of centralized nominations
Restricting the entry of legislators exclusively to wealthy aristocratic zamindars
The mandatory reduction of the total legislative council tenure down to a single year cycle
e: Detailed Explanation: The joint demands focused on democratic expansion. They explicitly stated that all legislative assemblies must be significantly enlarged, ensure a robust elected majority of non-officials, and be granted real, expanded powers over governance.

qe: What specific tenure duration was demanded by the joint platform of the Congress and Muslim League for the newly structured legislative councils in 1916?
qh: 1916 में कांग्रेस और मुस्लिम लीग के संयुक्त मंच द्वारा नवगठित विधान परिषदों के लिए कितनी विशिष्ट कार्यकाल अवधि (tenure duration) की मांग की गई थी?
o: Five years
Three years
Six years
Two years
e: Detailed Explanation: Under the terms of the joint demands formulated during the Lucknow Pact, the organizations proposed that the operational tenure of the legislative councils should be fixed at a standard duration of five years.

qe: The joint nationalist demands of the Lucknow Pact attacked a major fiscal component of the 'Economic Drain' relating to home charges. Which specific finance reform did they demand regarding the Secretary of State?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते की संयुक्त राष्ट्रवादी मांगों ने होम चार्जेज से संबंधित 'आर्थिक निकास' के एक प्रमुख वित्तीय घटक पर हमला किया। राज्य सचिव (Secretary of State) के संबंध में उन्होंने किस विशिष्ट वित्तीय सुधार की मांग की थी?
o: The salaries of the Secretary of State for India should be paid by the British treasury and not drawn from Indian funds
The complete legal transfer of the absolute revenue share of the Secretary of State directly to local municipalities
The total structural cancellation of any advisory council accompanying the Secretary of State in London
Forcing the Secretary of State to pay a metabolic transit duty on all imported British textiles
e: Detailed Explanation: Nationalists heavily criticized the practice where the salaries and administrative costs of the Secretary of State for India were drawn from Indian tax revenues. The Lucknow Pact demanded that these expenditures be paid directly out of the British Treasury, preventing an economic drain of Indian resources.

qe: What structural modification did the Lucknow Pact demand regarding the executive administrative bodies assisting the Viceroy and provincial governors?
qh: वायसराय और प्रांतीय राज्यपालों की सहायता करने वाले कार्यकारी प्रशासनिक निकायों के संबंध में लखनऊ समझौते ने किस संरचनात्मक संशोधन की मांग की थी?
o: At least half the members of the Viceroy’s and provincial governors’ executive councils should be Indians
The complete administrative transfer of executive powers to traditional village caste elders
The total legal abolition of any executive council structures across all presidencies
The mandatory restriction of council seats exclusively to European military officers from London
e: Detailed Explanation: The joint demands sought to Indianize the executive branch by stipulating that at least half the total members of both the central Viceroy's Executive Council and all provincial governors' executive councils must be composed of Indian nationals.

qe: From an analytical perspective, a major structural limitation of the executive-legislature relations proposed under the Lucknow Pact was that:
qh: विश्लेषणात्मक दृष्टिकोण से, लखनऊ समझौते के तहत प्रस्तावित कार्यपालिका-विधायिका संबंधों की एक बड़ी संरचनात्मक सीमा यह थी कि:
o: The executive as a whole was not made responsible to the legislature, and the legislature could not remove the elected half of the executive
The non-official elected members held an absolute sovereign veto power to instantly dissolve the Viceroy's office
The entire public finance budget framework was completely insulated from any legislative discussion or overview
The local bodies were completely barred from recommending any non-official members to the provincial benches
e: Detailed Explanation: A critical drawback of the scheme was the lack of executive responsibility. Although half the executive was to be elected by the legislature, the executive branch remained independent and could not be removed or voted out by the legislative body, making a constitutional deadlock highly probable when passing budgets.

qe: Why do economic and political historians classify the constitutional reform demands formulated under the 1916 Lucknow Pact as merely an expanded version of the Morley-Minto reforms?
qh: आर्थिक और राजनीतिक इतिहासकार 1916 के लखनऊ समझौते के तहत तैयार की गई संवैधानिक सुधारों की मांगों को केवल मॉर्ले-मिंटो सुधारों का एक विस्तारित संस्करण क्यों मानते हैं?
o: They introduced expanded representative forms and legislative debates but conceded no actual administrative responsibility to the legislature
They completely endorsed the preservation of the fatalistic niyati (destiny) principles across all land revenue systems
They directly supported the total legal retention of British managing agencies over all coastal maritime trade routes
They completely froze any future constitutional advance toward the grant of autonomous self-government inside the colonies
e: Detailed Explanation: The Lucknow Pact demands mirrored the structural flaws of the 1909 Indian Councils Act. While they expanded the number of seats and introduced elective components, they did not alter the core colonial setup—they failed to grant actual ministerial or executive responsibility to the elected legislature, keeping the administration a benevolent despotism.

qe: What serious negative consequence did the Congress's acceptance of separate electorates under the Lucknow Pact inadvertently produce regarding the long-term socio-political landscape of India?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते के तहत अलग निर्वाचन क्षेत्रों (separate electorates) को कांग्रेस की स्वीकृति देने से अनजाने में भारत के दीर्घकालिक सामाजिक-राजनीतिक परिदृश्य पर क्या गंभीर नकारात्मक परिणाम पड़ा?
o: It implied that the Congress and the League came together as separate political entities, marking a major landmark in the evolution of the two-nation theory
It forced the immediate and complete absolute liquidation of the All India Muslim League structure
It caused a sudden structural drop in the baseline primary productivity metrics of all agricultural fields
It permanently blocked any future reunion or cooperation between the Moderate and Extremist factions
e: Detailed Explanation: By formally accepting separate electorates, the Congress recognized the League as the sole representative of Muslims on a communal basis. This treated the two communities as separate political entities, which inadvertently validated communal narratives and marked a major landmark in the evolution of the 'two-nation theory'.

qe: A major structural oversight of the unified elite leadership during the execution of the Lucknow Pact was that:
qh: लखनऊ समझौते के निष्पादन के दौरान एकीकृत कुलीन नेतृत्व (elite leadership) की एक बड़ी संरचनात्मक चूक क्या थी?
o: While the leaders of the two groups came together, no concrete efforts were made to bring together the masses from the two communities
They completely refused to present any joint constitutional demands to the British government
They focused their entire charter on securing financial subsidies exclusively for wealthy urban zamindars
They required all future national agitations to be conducted strictly in classical European languages
e: Detailed Explanation: The Lucknow Pact was primarily an alliance between the elite leadership of the Congress and the Muslim League. A major oversight was that the top-level agreement was not accompanied by any structural campaigns or grass-roots efforts to bridge communal divides and bring the masses of the two communities together.

qe: From the perspective of the Indian National Congress, what was the primary motivating factor behind their controversial decision to accept the principle of separate electorates in 1916?
qh: भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के दृष्टिकोण से, 1916 में पृथक निर्वाचन मंडल के सिद्धांत को स्वीकार करने के उनके विवादास्पद निर्णय के पीछे प्राथमिक प्रेरक कारक क्या था?
o: A serious desire to allay minority fears of majority domination to present a united nationalist front to the government
A mandate forced upon them by a direct legal decree passed by the newly established Federal Court
To completely destroy the growing political popularity and mass base of the Extremists led by Tilak
To secure high-cost private banking and insurance credit lines from British managing agencies directly
e: Detailed Explanation: The Congress agreed to separate electorates out of a pragmatic desire to forge national unity. They wanted to allay the deep-seated fears among the Muslim minority regarding Hindu majority domination under a future self-governing system, thereby presenting a strong, unified nationalist front to the colonial rulers.

qe: The massive public enthusiasm and political unity generated by the 1916 Lucknow reunion and Pact directly influenced the government to issue which landmark strategic declaration in August 1917?
qh: 1916 के लखनऊ पुनर्मिलन और समझौते द्वारा उत्पन्न भारी जन उत्साह और राजनीतिक एकता ने सीधे तौर पर सरकार को अगस्त 1917 में कौन सी ऐतिहासिक रणनीतिक घोषणा जारी करने के लिए प्रभावित किया?
o: Montagu's August Declaration promising the progressive realization of self-government
Lord Curzon's official proclamation implementing the permanent sub-infeudation guidelines
The judicial decree passed by the King-in-Council dissolving the Board of Control in London
The explicit text codes introducing non-caloric artificial sweetening standards across markets
e: Detailed Explanation: The unified political front of the Congress and the League, combined with the Home Rule agitations, forced a shift in British strategy. This directly pressure the Secretary of State Edwin Montagu to issue his historic August 1917 Declaration, which officially promised the gradual development of self-governing institutions in India.

qe: What profound socio-political realization did Ambika Charan Majumdar encapsulate in his presidential address regarding the ten-year separation of the two wings of the nationalist party?
qh: अंबिका चरण मजूमदार ने अपने अध्यक्षीय भाषण में राष्ट्रवादी पार्टी के दोनों पंखों के दस साल के अलगाव के संबंध में किस गहरे सामाजिक-राजनीतिक अहसास को व्यक्त किया था?
o: That both wings had realized the fact that united they stand, but divided they fall
That the passive resistance methodology was bookish and completely obsolete for mass work
That the lower strata of society completely lacked the capacity to participate or make sacrifices
That political freedom was an academic pastime restricted strictly to the intellectual elite
e: Detailed Explanation: In his famous presidential address at Lucknow, A.C. Majumdar noted that after nearly ten years of painful separation and wanderings through the wilderness of misunderstanding, both wings of the Indian Nationalist Party (Moderates and Extremists) had come to realize the structural reality that 'united they stand, but divided they fall'.

qe: A logistics mapping pathway charts a right-angled triangular configuration. A survey vehicle moves 24 km North from central depot O, and then shifts orientation to drive 7 km East to reach target delivery spot D. Calculate the direct straight-line distance from O to D.
qh: एक कार डिपो O से 24 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलती है, और फिर दिशा बदलकर पूर्व की ओर 7 किमी जाकर गंतव्य D पर पहुँचती है। O से D की सीधी रेखा की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
o: 25 km
31 km
28 km
30 km
e:
Detailed Explanation: This spatial path sets up a right-angled triangle with perpendicular legs measuring 24 km and 7 km. The straight-line distance is the hypotenuse.
Applying the Pythagoras theorem: $\text{Distance} = \sqrt{24^2 + 7^2} = \sqrt{576 + 49} = \sqrt{625} = \mathbf{25\text{ km}}$.

qe: In a biological survey tracking energy parameters across a terrestrial ecosystem, if the Gross Primary Productivity (GPP) of an alluvial biome is 42,000 units and the measured Net Primary Productivity (NPP) is 22,000 units, calculate the energy spent during plant metabolic respiration (R).
qh: एक स्थलीय पारितंत्र में ऊर्जा मापदंडों का मानचित्रण करने वाले एक जैविक सर्वेक्षण में, यदि सकल प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (GPP) 42,000 इकाइयाँ है और मापी गई शुद्ध प्राथमिक उत्पादकता (NPP) 22,000 इकाइयाँ है, तो पौधों के श्वसन (R) के दौरान खर्च की गई ऊर्जा की गणना करें।
o: 20,000 units
64,000 units
30,000 units
15,000 units
e:
Detailed Explanation: Utilizing the foundational ecological productivity balance equation: $NPP = GPP - R$, we isolate the value for respiration losses: $R = GPP - NPP$.
Substituting the values: $R = 42,000 - 22,000 = \mathbf{20,000\text{ units}}$.

qe: The 'Young Party' of the Muslim League before 1916 was turning to bolder nationalist politics and outgrowing the limited political outlook of which historic school of thought?
qh: 1916 से पहले मुस्लिम लीग की 'यंग पार्टी' अधिक साहसिक राष्ट्रवादी राजनीति की ओर बढ़ रही थी और किस ऐतिहासिक विचारधारा के सीमित राजनीतिक दृष्टिकोण से बाहर निकल रही थी?
o: The Aligarh School
The Deoband School
The Tattvabodhini Sabha
The Young Bengal Derozian Network
e: Detailed Explanation: The younger generation of the Muslim League sought to outgrow the loyalist, pro-British political outlook associated with the traditional Aligarh School founded by Sir Syed Ahmed Khan, shifting their platform toward active anti-imperialist cooperation with the Congress.

qe: Which prominent 'Young Party' Muslim League leaders faced harsh state internment and imprisonment by the British administration during the First World War, intensifying anti-imperialist sentiments among the masses?
qh: प्रथम विश्व युद्ध के दौरान ब्रिटिश प्रशासन द्वारा किस प्रमुख 'यंग पार्टी' मुस्लिम लीग के नेताओं को कड़ी नजरबंदी और जेल का सामना करना पड़ा, जिससे जनता के बीच साम्राज्यवादी विरोधी भावनाएं तेज हो गईं?
o: The Ali brothers, Maulana Azad, and Hasrat Mohani
Nawab Salimullah and Nawab Mohsin-ul-Mulk exclusively
Sir Syed Ahmed Khan and the Agha Khan
Mirza Ghulam Ahmad and Shah Walliullah
e: Detailed Explanation: The colonial government deployed heavy repression during the war, interning vocal younger Muslim leaders like the Ali brothers (Shaukat Ali and Mohammad Ali), Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, and Hasrat Mohani, which destroyed any remaining illusions of British benevolence among young Muslims.

qe: What specific operational privilege did the Lucknow Pact demand regarding the duration and stability of the newly expanded Legislative Councils?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते ने नव विस्तारित विधान परिषदों की अवधि और स्थिरता के संबंध में किस विशिष्ट परिचालन विशेषाधिकार की मांग की थी?
o: The term of the Legislative Council should be fixed at five years
The Council should be subject to arbitrary dissolution by the Viceroy every year
The structural tenure should be reduced down to a single six-month emergency window
The operational duration should be directly dependent on the budget approvals of London
e: Detailed Explanation: To ensure legislative stability and prevent arbitrary dissolutions by the executive governors, the joint Congress-League demands specified that the fixed term of the legislative councils must be structured as five years.

qe: Why did the unified nationalist front demand under the Lucknow Pact that representative assemblies must have an 'elected majority'?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते के तहत संयुक्त राष्ट्रवादी मोर्चे ने क्यों मांग की कि प्रतिनिधि विधानसभाओं में 'निर्वाचित बहुमत' (elected majority) होना चाहिए?
o: To dismantle the official bureaucratic majority that allowed the government to pass arbitrary measures easily
To ensure that only wealthy aristocratic zamindars could enter the provincial benches
To completely replace the constitutional legal oversight managed by the High Courts
To enforce the mandatory recruitment of military officers into the legislative councils
e: Detailed Explanation: Prior to 1916, the councils were dominated by official majorities or nominated elites who rubber-stamped government proposals. Demanding a robust elected majority was a direct attempt to tip the balance of legislative power in favor of representative Indian public opinion.

qe: The joint demands of the Lucknow Pact outlined that if the legislature disagreed with the executive over crucial matters like the budget, it would most likely produce what systemic outcome?
qh: लखनऊ समझौते की संयुक्त मांगों में रेखांकित किया गया था कि यदि बजट जैसे महत्वपूर्ण मामलों पर विधायिका का कार्यपालिका से मतभेद होता है, तो इससे किस प्रणालीगत परिणाम (systemic outcome) की सबसे अधिक संभावना होगी?
o: A constitutional deadlock
The automatic dissolution of the legislature
The immediate legal intervention of the Federal Court
The complete financial bankruptcy of the British Treasury
e: Detailed Explanation: Because the executive branch was not responsible to the legislature and could not be removed by it, yet remained dependent on the legislature's approval to clear fiscal budgets, any serious political disagreement between the two branches was structurally bound to cause a constitutional deadlock.

qe: How did the internal composition of the All India Muslim League's leadership change significantly in the years immediately leading up to the 1916 Lucknow Pact?
qh: 1916 के लखनऊ समझौते के ठीक पहले के वर्षों में अखिल भारतीय मुस्लिम लीग के नेतृत्व की आंतरिक संरचना में क्या महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव आया था?
o: It became increasingly dominated by younger militant nationalists who shared anti-imperialist objectives
It was taken over entirely by conservative British managing agency directors based in Calcutta
The leadership voluntarily dissolved its framework to integrate with the orthodox Dharma Sabha
It completely restricted its membership parameter to uneducated landless agricultural ryots
e: Detailed Explanation: The political convergence was made possible because the old, conservative, loyalist leadership of the League was gradually replaced and dominated by a younger generation of militant nationalists who held progressive, anti-imperialist views identical to the Congress.

qe: The dynamic background work towards achieving the historic Moderate-Extremist reunion at Lucknow in 1916 was primarily driven by the vigorous efforts of which two leaders?
qh: 1916 में लखनऊ में ऐतिहासिक नरमपंथी-गरमपंथी पुनर्मिलन को प्राप्त करने की दिशा में गतिशील पृष्ठभूमि का काम मुख्य रूप से किन दो नेताओं के जोरदार प्रयासों से संचालित था?
o: Annie Besant and Bal Gangadhar Tilak
Ambika Charan Majumdar and Gopal Krishna Gokhale
Pherozshah Mehta and W.C. Bonnerjee
Mahadeo Govind Ranade and Raghunath Rao
e: Detailed Explanation: The historic reconciliation at Lucknow was not an accidental occurrence; it was built on years of patient, vigorous political campaigns and background negotiations led by the Irish theosophist Annie Besant and the Extremist leader Lokmanya Bal Gangadhar Tilak.
